thread:
akshay: Heads-up: planning RBAC change for private cluster tomorrow AM. Goal: prevent model-fetcher SA from calling KMS Decrypt. Need audit and KMS checklist reviewed first.
maria: Clarify: we're removing iam:Decrypt from the cluster principal and introducing a KMS Sign-only short-lived role for artifact attestation?
akshay: Correct. Model-fetcher will request signatures only (KMS:Sign) and verifier will validate locally. Full Decrypt denied except via emergency flow.
lucy: How are we surfacing KMS calls in logs? For forensics we need immutable evidence linking request->response.
akshay: Plan: use cloud KMS audit events forwarded to sec-logging over TLS, plus a signed, append-only local audit blob with per-batch sha256 and HMAC; HMAC keys stored in vault. Forwarded events land in long-term bucket with object-lock enabled.
sec-bot: [automated] Current audit-forwarder: TLS on 6514, cert rotation cadence 7d.
maria: Network restrictions? Model-fetch nodes are in a semi-shared subnet. We must restrict egress to only KMS endpoint, registry, and our monitoring stack.
lucy: Recommended: pod-level default deny egress netpol, allow egress to internal egress-proxy and specific IP ranges for KMS. For on-prem without proxy, route through NAT jumpbox with host firewall rules and explicit allowlist.
akshay: We'll add nftables host-level rules as another layer. Also enable cluster egress logging (conntrack) for additional telemetry.
oncall-ops: Emergency access: if Decrypt is needed to recover quickly, can we provision a temporary Decrypt grant?
akshay: Yes — emergency runbook will allow a time-limited Decrypt grant to an emergency principal, with two approvers and automatic expiry (1h). All approvals recorded in audit logs.
maria: Vulnerability note: SBOM scan flagged older curl in edge-fetcher image. If exploited, could it fetch a malicious artifact. Impact: limited because admission controller enforces image signature verification and images run read-only. Still, patch ASAP and rotate image signatures.
sec-bot: [automated] Admission policy: image signature verification = ENFORCED for prod-private, WARN for staging.
infrastructure-sre: For RBAC rollout: canary in sandbox tenant, validate audit events under load — we previously saw rare drops under burst. Also test the correlation ID propagation end-to-end.
akshay: Action plan: 1) Sandbox canary 09:00 tomorrow 2) Audit-forwarder stress test 3) Validate KMS signer workflow + emergency grant 4) Prod change window after signoff.
maria: I'll own audit-to-splunk validation and object-lock lifecycle.
lucy: I'll author netpol + nftables snippets and the emergency grant runbook.
oncall-ops: I'll be on-call for the canary. Paste canary commands and netpol snippets into follow-up thread.
akshay: One more: add X-RDW-AUDIT-ID header propagated from signer to KMS request to correlate traces. Ensure time sync (UTC ISO8601).
maria: +1. Also store per-batch checksums in vault and mirror to cold S3 with object-lock for 90d.
akshay: Roadmap note: this rollout will use shared CMK with signer-per-tenant mapping; migration to per-tenant CMKs planned next quarter.
sec-bot: [automated] Incident playbook: https://intra.redwood/ops/playbooks/kms-emergency-recovery
akshay: Will post diffs and rollback steps after sandbox run. :white_check_mark:
